bio: Department Associate Global Health and Population, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Global Health and Population Francesco is a Postdoctoral Research Associate working with Dr. Stéphane Verguet on priority setting and resource allocation in low-and middle-income countries. His research interests lie in the application of economic evaluation to inform decision making in health care, with a focus on public health interventions with impacts on multiple sectors. Prior to joining the Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, he was research fellow at the Centre for Health Economics (University of York) and at the Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal). BSc, Economics University of Trieste
